# Independent audit: odd integer product and absence of heavy fibers

Audited `candidate 9bd56c5f5923c55d` in full. **PASS.** The underlying thin-edge certificate has the separate full audit `historical context (not an accepted premise)`.

The fifteen actual fibers and their volumes are preserved by the product body. The within-fiber covariance is unchanged because every old fiber is repeated the same five times. Every individual fiber has mass strictly below one fourth of the new total.

The paired-tail theorem gives the all-ambient lower bound at the central simplex centroid, including arbitrary new integer tilt. Its strict nonzero-shift refinement is valid in the dimension four used here; I checked the statement and its independently audited attained-localization proof in `candidate d494e7e71949ac0b` and `historical context (not an accepted premise)`. The low-dimensional equality exceptions are irrelevant here and are not silently invoked.

The actual deepest-base exclusion is correct. At old endpoint base, a finite old-base tilt isolates the endpoint column, whose total volume is five endpoint volumes. At new base t=+1 or -1, a sufficiently large new-base tilt captures at most one full old copy beyond the source level and leaves the source-level old cap independently selectable. Thus the upper bound M_0+Q_old holds; at t=+2 or -2 the full-copy term vanishes. These quantities lie strictly below the paired central lower bound for the chosen small parameters. All deepest bases are therefore exactly (0,0).

The low-cap compactness argument uses only the five middle simplex fibers and keeps every ambient tilt. A divergent new tilt would give two full middle fibers plus the central own cap, exceeding the permitted low cap mass by the positive gap 2-4 Gamma_4. After bounded subsequence extraction, a nonzero limiting tilt contradicts the strict paired-tail theorem, while zero tilt forces a canonical simplex direction by the ordinary equality classification. This proves localization uniformly as delta and h become small, including at the old deepest mark used later.

Within the localized canonical cones, all five middle cuts and all their smoothing strips remain strict vertex cuts. Their masses are positive constants times fourth powers of positive affine threshold distances. Averaging over the uniform outward width preserves strictly positive second threshold derivative. Pairing new integer levels therefore makes the middle sum strictly larger than its zero-new-tilt value whenever the new tilt is nonzero.

The exact endpoint lower costs survive the two-coordinate pairing: pair (-1,t,x) with (1,-t,R_J x). Both integer terms cancel, and the same fixed positive continuous-margin reserve forces the edge-cone contribution to be at least five endpoint volumes. Outside the two edge cones, nonnegativity and the zero-tilt missed competitor suffice. Hence the strict middle improvement cannot be offset at the endpoints, and every low active cap has new tilt exactly zero.

Applying the same comparison at the old deepest mark, before assuming it is new-deepest, proves its new raw depth is exactly five times the old one. The zero-new-tilt upper bound then forces every new deepest mark to be old-deepest, proving the stated uniqueness without circularity. This also identifies the entire active family in both directions.

Every actual coarea is multiplied by five, so both quantile and response balance are unchanged. A globally convex physical field restricts at each fixed new integer level to an admissible old field. Applying the same old-menu inequality at all five levels and summing therefore proves the full new cone bound, including fields coupling both integer coordinates and the continuous variables. The surface measure is explicitly the fiber-boundary sum, not ambient surface area.

The result excludes global no-heavy-fiber assumptions as a repair of the universal individual best-menu efficiency assertion. Its one occupied deepest-source parity and its depth far above Gamma_4/4 remain explicit limitations. No failure of OC or of an allocation using the full parity budget follows.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
